desc:
EMOTIA - where every dying human's last emotion defines their afterlife.
The Emotion Prison has been taken over by Corrupted Emotians.
Team up with up to four friends to venture deep into the dungeon-like prison, full of puzzles and mysteries.
Do not let their adorable looks fool you - You will soon be faced with deadlier and darker threats.
Cleanse the Corrupted Emotians and bring peace to the Emotion Prison.
And remember - you cannot do this alone.

⭐Features
👥Single-player & Multi-player (Up to 5 players)
🧩Puzzle-solving & Teamwork
🚩Intense Chases
👣Descend Deeper
🎯Challenging Missions
👾Customizable Characters and Upgrades
